facts: Aseguradoras invokes docs-aseguradora with entidad=aseguradora, entidadId and aseguradoraId.
The browser Drive provider forwards entidad and entidadId to the backend.
Backend authorizeTarget only implements gestion/gestiones and otherwise unconditionally resolves a clientes document from clienteId.
Insurer document requests therefore cannot authorize an aseguradoras record and can fail before Drive upload.
Backend refsFrom does not include the insurer docs array used by the importer, so insurer readback provenance cannot be authorized even if metadata is durably linked.
Preview Drive guards are client-ID based and do not recognize the exact synthetic insurer scope required by R13.

requiredFix: Add fail-closed aseguradora target authorization through the canonical product operational authorization owner.
Recognize insurer docs references for readback.
Permit only exact synthetic b4-/b4_ insurer targets in Preview automated Drive writes, while leaving real insurer Preview writes denied.
Keep production and Preview callables separate; deploy Preview Drive callables only for exact R13 proof.
